sessionManager.abandonRequiresInterrupted: Session {{sessionId}} is currently "{{status}}", not "interrupted" — cannot abandon it
sessionManager.continueRequiresInterrupted: Session {{sessionId}} is currently "{{status}}", not "interrupted" — cannot continue it
sessionManager.continueUnsupportedBackend: Session {{sessionId}}'s backend ({{adapterType}}) does not support "continue (keep memory)", or its backend session ID was not captured before the crash — use "take over" instead
sessionManager.vanishedDuringContinue: Session {{sessionId}} unexpectedly disappeared during the "continue" flow

sessionNetwork.cannotSendToSelf: A session cannot send a message to itself (use list_sessions to find another session)
sessionNetwork.targetUnavailable: Session {{sessionId}} ("{{title}}") is currently "{{status}}" and cannot receive messages
sessionNetwork.chainBudgetExceeded: This conversation chain has reached its message limit of {{limit}} and was halted — user intervention is needed (typing a new message in the UI starts a new chain)
sessionNetwork.createdButNotDelivered: Session {{sessionId}} was created, but sending its first message failed: {{detail}}
sessionNetwork.cannotForwardToSelf: A message cannot be forwarded to its own source session
